Integrations

VibeVoice ASR

VibeVoice ASR integration for audio transcription with diarization.

Features:

  • arrow_forwardSpeaker diarization (who spoke when)
  • arrow_forwardHigh-accuracy transcription
  • arrow_forwardMulti-language support
  • arrow_forwardTimestamp alignment

Configuration:

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
phases:
  - name: ingestion
    node: IngestionNode
    config:
      extract_audio: true
      asr_model: vibevoice
      diarization: true

Usage:

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
from deep_research_engine.utils.asr import asr_transcribe

result = await asr_transcribe(
    audio_path="audio.mp3",
    model="vibevoice",
    diarization=True
)

print(result.transcript)
print(result.speakers)  # Speaker segments

LangFuse Prompt Management

LangFuse integration for prompt management and tracing.

Features:

  • arrow_forwardCentralized prompt storage
  • arrow_forwardVersion control for prompts
  • arrow_forwardA/B testing
  • arrow_forwardExecution tracing

Configuration:

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
export LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY=pk-lf-...
export LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY=sk-lf-...
export LANGFUSE_HOST=https://cloud.langfuse.com

Usage:

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
from langfuse import Langfuse

langfuse = Langfuse()

prompt = langfuse.get_prompt("research-brief")
response = llm.generate(prompt.prompt, **prompt.config)

langfuse.trace(
    name="research",
    prompt=prompt,
    generation=response
)

Internal Documents

DRY Cleanup Report

Analysis of code duplication across the 4 unified projects.

Findings:

  • arrow_forwardAll 4 projects use same Boss → Workers → Critic → Synthesis pattern
  • arrow_forward80% code duplication in graph logic
  • arrow_forwardState classes had 50+ fields (bloated)
  • arrow_forwardStorage logic duplicated across projects

Actions:

  • arrow_forwardExtracted common pattern to engine
  • arrow_forwardGeneric 18-field state
  • arrow_forwardPluggable storage backends
  • arrow_forwardConfig-driven workflows

Phased Ingestion Summary

Two-stage ingestion pipeline design.

Stage A: Ingestion

  • arrow_forwardParse raw data
  • arrow_forwardProcess content
  • arrow_forwardQuality check
  • arrow_forwardStore results

Stage B: Inference

  • arrow_forwardQuery decomposition
  • arrow_forwardFan-out to workers
  • arrow_forwardSynthesize findings
